denominator_warning: This panel is 25 conditions and yields a LARGER two-sided gene set than the 11-condition expression panel used by every prior artifact in this arc. Do not mix the two denominators; `restricted_to_prior_gene_set` carries the continuity view.

interpretation.PROVABLY_UNCALLABLE: no medium/objective/constraint layer can move them (prior work)
interpretation.NEVER_FIRES: structurally capable but the model never predicts essential in ANY labelled condition -- the objective never demands the product
interpretation.MIS_CONDITIONED: the model DOES fire, just never in a condition the experiment calls essential -- a condition-modelling / calibration problem
interpretation.PARTIAL_OVERLAP: fires in at least one correct condition; misses the rest

caveats: The 'ever fires' test spans ALL labelled carbon conditions, not just the 11 with expression -- deliberately generous, so NEVER_FIRES is a conservative claim.
Condition modelling here is sole-carbon-source only. A gene whose true dependence is on aeration, pH or a nitrogen source cannot be caught by this panel and will read as NEVER_FIRES.
Model reach, not biology: this partitions the MODEL's failure modes, not the cell's.
